item.title: Jump Trading builds new microwave link between Chicago and New Jersey
item.description: Jump Trading is building a new microwave network connecting the CME data center in Aurora to equity exchanges in New Jersey, shaving microseconds off its round trip, filings show.

item.title: Two Sigma Deploys 10,000-GPU Cluster in New Data Center
item.description: Two Sigma Investments has deployed a 10,000-GPU cluster in a new data center in New Jersey to train larger forecasting models.

item.title: FPGA Engineer - Trading Systems
item.description: Hudson River Trading is hiring an FPGA Engineer to design and verify low-latency trading logic in Verilog and SystemVerilog.
